title: W33 Local K33 Chart Correction
parallel_hint: BT689 claimed W(3,3) -> AG(2,3) -> K33 via point perp-planes.
correction: For a point P in W(3,3), P^perp has 13 projective points, not 9: P plus four punctured lines of size 3.
repaired_chain: W33 point -> perp pencil of 4 punctured lines -> choose 2 directions -> K33 virtual affine chart
boundary: K33 is a local virtual affine chart from a pair of punctured perp-lines, not the whole P^perp set.
